verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs list image-to-video in its current video model, and I2V generation is priced per clip, so animating a still image is a first-party capability. The evidence never documents that the source image's subject and composition carry through into the motion; character reference and keyframes are listed alongside but are not tied to fidelity to the source still. Missing for 10: documented preservation of subject and composition from the source image, I2V-specific guides or parameters, and independent hands-on corroboration of image-to-video fidelity.

support.subject: As a creator, I can animate a still image into motion with the subject and composition preserved
